requirements.title: Add a payment card
requirements.description: A signed-in customer saves a payment card and pays with it at the pump.
requirements.intended_use: Pay at the pump with a saved card

criteria.given: a signed-in customer with no saved card
criteria.when: they add a valid Visa card
criteria.then: the card is the default payment method

requirements.title: Card vault tokenizes cards
requirements.description: The cards API exchanges the card number for a provider token and stores only the token.

criteria.statement: POST /cards returns 201 with a token and never stores the card number
